descriptions.w3d_update_jetpack_effects_800ae9d0: Start or stop the observed jetpack engine and first effect according to the two input controls; replace/release the held voice effect through the original service names and forward the input vector to all three effect interfaces. Inline per-branch first-effect setup preserves original shared control flow. Receiver/context/interface views are partial and game-owned; roles and signatures inferred, with original null-handling retained. No local aggregate allocation or external-data ownership is claimed.
